description: This file provides a ValidationService class implementing validation run execution, report generation and retrieval functionalities for a data validation system. It includes methods for running various validation checks on submissions, managing validation reports, and listing validation runs, as well as internal checks like schema conformance, freshness, and completeness.

classes.name: ValidationService
classes.description: Service for validation run execution and report management, including validation checks and report storage.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] run_validation( self, submission_id: str, validation_profile: str = "baseline", actor_user_id: str = "system", actor_role: str = "system", correlation_id: str = "", )
methods.description: Executes a validation run for a submission, performs checks, saves report artifacts, updates submission state, and records audit events.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_validation_report(self, validation_run_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a previously generated validation report using its validation run ID.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_validation_runs(self, submission_id: str)
methods.description: Lists all validation runs associated with a specific submission.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _check_schema_conformance(self, package: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Internal check for schema conformance based on dataset hash, failing if placeholder hash detected.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _check_freshness(self, package: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Internal check for dataset freshness; currently returns a passing check with mock metrics.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _check_completeness(self, package: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Internal check for data completeness; currently returns a passing check with mock metrics.
